description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). Escrow a1: a finalized open, and one release (same block hash and index) read twice with block numbers 120 and 121. Escrow b2: one release read twice, once with block number 130 and once with null. A block hash fixes the block number, so both are conflicting evidence and both escrows are unverified. Escrow c3 has one clean release and stays claimed.
